contentText: An economically fragile country caught up in Russia’s hybrid war, Moldova is keen to make rapid progress for a quicker membership to the European Union. With the opening of the first chapter of accession negotiations, the EU launched its  €1.9 billion investment plan in the country. With this plan, which is conditional on domestic structural reforms,  Europe hopes to draw in businesses and drive change in the country.
